Explore Graduate Education at UA Little Rock
Take the next step in your education and career with a graduate degree from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock.
UA Little Rock offers graduate certificates, master’s degrees and doctoral programs with flexible learning options and experienced faculty invested in your success. Located in Arkansas’s capital, the university connects you with employers and opportunities for hands-on research, internships, and creative work. Whether you’re advancing your career or exploring a new direction, you’ll find opportunities to grow.
Explore Graduate Programs
Why Choose Graduate School at UA Little Rock?
Earn your degree through flexible and affordable programs. Learn from dedicated faculty, gain valuable research experience, and build career-ready skills. Graduate assistantships and other financial support are available.
Steps to Apply to Graduate School
How Much Does Grad School Cost?
Graduate School Tuition & Fees
Graduate tuition is charged per credit hour. For 2026-2027, Arkansas residents pay about $344–$372 per credit hour in graduate tuition, while non-residents pay about $777–$793 per credit hour, depending on the program.
Students pay additional mandatory fees.
How Can You Pay for Graduate School?
The Get Your Feet Wet scholarship helps new graduate students get started by covering in-state tuition for one three-credit-hour course during their first semester. UA Little Rock recently announced the largest investment in graduate assistant stipends in more than a decade, increasing financial support for master’s and doctoral students in fall 2026.
